<cite ref="Mishnah Tevul Yom 1:4">T’bul Yom I, 4</cite>. Tanḥ. ed. Bub., B’midb. 27; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 695">Yalk. Num. 695</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 22:22">Prov. XXII, 22</cite>, by ref. to <cite ref="Berakhot 35b:2">Ber. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>כל הנהנה … גוזל וכ׳</he>) <he>זה הת׳ שהוא נכנס … לא יאמר … ומניח את הת׳</he> this refers to the lupine that is brought in with the dessert; one should not say, I have nuts and dates before me, I will say the blessing over them, and disregard the lupine; a. fr.—Pl. <he>תּוּרְמוֹסִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 4:6">Makhsh. IV, 6</cite> (Mish. ed. <he>תּוּרְמְסִין</he>, <he>תּוּרְמְסִים</he>; ed. Dehr. 7 <he>תִּרְמוֹסִין</he>).
